subject.title: Control UI: Worktrees mutation errors disappear during refresh

question: Which open pull request should be the canonical implementation for the Worktrees mutation-error persistence fix?
rationale: The protected issue has three competing closing PRs whose state-clearing boundaries and proof strength need explicit maintainer comparison before one is selected.

options.title: Prefer PR 106196
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196 first because its supplied evidence covers the real authenticated Gateway failure, rendered Playwright flow, focused tests, and changed-surface checks.

options.title: Choose a narrower patch
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106190 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106199 if exact diff review shows its error-lifecycle boundary is safer, then close the other candidates.

recommendation.title: Prefer PR 106196
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196 first because its supplied evidence covers the real authenticated Gateway failure, rendered Playwright flow, focused tests, and changed-surface checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the issue reproduction and the candidate with the strongest described real-behavior proof.
